name: lexical-bundles
title: Lexical bundles and phrase frames
description: Recurrent word sequences (lexical bundles) above a normalized frequency and range threshold, with dispersion and examples, plus the phrase frames (p-frames) that show their variable slots. Useful for EAP/ESP teaching materials and register studies.

min_per_million.description: Minimum normalized frequency (Biber et al. use 20-40 per million).

examples.description: Bundles to enrich with dispersion and examples.

interpretation: Bundles are frequent, widely distributed word sequences (only sequences made of words are kept). Classify them by function (referential: 'the end of the'; stance: 'it is important to'; discourse organizing: 'on the other hand') and by structure (NP/PP-based, VP-based, dependent-clause). P-frames show fixed frames with a variable slot (TOP_VARIANTS lists the fillers; high ENTROPY = open slot). Use EXAMPLE sentences from 'evidence' for teaching material.
